prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1426; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of pain and reduced function in the right knee. Over the course of 28 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, range-of-motion and strengthening exercises, and periodic reassessment by the treating provider. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury, largely to address persistent stiffness and gradual progress in strength. Examination findings included localized tenderness and a positive response on certain stability maneuvers that support the reported injury, while other orthopedic and neurovascular tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this knee. Billing records reviewed for the episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Current status is improving, with ongoing home exercise and a plan for discharge from active therapy once functional goals are met.
